name: Ashiya Suzuka
source:
A waitress at Cafe Lakeside where the Player also works. The Player's senpai by one year, she attends a different school in a neighboring town. Suzuka is as cheerful as she sounds like which makes her very easy to chat with. She loves fashion and entertainment, and always goes full-power when it's for something fun. The people around find her "cool" and admire her for it, but really, all Suzuka wants is to become more feminine. One aspect of her is that if you praise her clothes, she'll get all red in the face and cutesy on you. Maybe because she's the youngest of a large family, instead of enjoying living by herself, you'll often find her hanging out with other girls.

[Quickly translated from erogamescape]
